title: refcheck config show --json
description: Every value a run started in one directory resolves, one row per key and layer. A key with several contributing layers, such as scan.exclude, has a row for each. A config file refcheck cannot take as written exits 2 and prints no document.

start.description: The directory the run would start in.

key.description: A config key as table.key, or user_config, repo_config or rules_file for a file refcheck reads or writes.

value.description: The resolved value. Null where no such file applies, such as a repo with no repo config.

layer.description: What set the value: a config file, an environment variable, a default or a built-in list.

note.description: What a reader should know about the value, such as the file not being there. Null where there is nothing.
